items.proposed: do not record EGFR as a selection biomarker
items.reason: In cohort B4, EGFR amplification is one of alternative WHO CNS5 diagnostic features of GBM ("OR one or more of the following molecular features of GBM: ... EGFR gene amplification"), not a separate entry requirement; like IDH-wildtype used to define GBM it is diagnostic. Not candidate-matched either way, and any_molecular_selection stays true from PD-L1.

items.coder_A: experimental_combination, uncertain (fixed dose in every arm; could be soc_backbone)
items.reason: Although every arm receives it, the trial's own question is the combination: "To determine the Maximum Tolerated Dose (MTD) of ASTX660 in combination with Pembrolizumab" and safety of "the combination of ASTX660 and Pembrolizumab"; pembrolizumab is an IMP, not background or pre-existing therapy. C3 says the investigational question decides; both are investigational (cf. the nivolumab + ipilimumab example).

items.proposed: PD_L1, enrichment (arms: Part B-Expansion), candidate_matched true (pembrolizumab)
items.reason: "Cohort B2: Patients with PD-L1 positive Cervical Cancer" is a cohort entry requirement (enrichment) on the ligand of pembrolizumab's target, so under §5 it is candidate-matched if pembrolizumab is a candidate. The manual has no rule restricting matching to the GBM cohort of a basket.

items.coder_B: PD_L1, enrichment, matched pembrolizumab, uncertain (enriches only cervical cohort B2, not GBM cohort B4)
items.reason: Same row: literal §5 makes candidate_matched_selection true at trial level. Whether enrichment of a non-GBM cohort should count toward the GBM primary outcome is a policy question no ruling settles.

note: Primary outcome hinges on a non-GBM cohort: PD-L1 enrichment applies only to cervical cohort B2, while the GBM cohort B4 ("no longer recruiting") has no candidate-matched selection. XL should decide whether basket-trial biomarker matching counts only for cohorts GBM can enter; if so, candidate_matched_selection becomes false. If pembrolizumab were instead soc_backbone (C3), the PD-L1 match would also fall away.
